sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking is a 4-billion-parameter dense vision-language model from the Qwen3-VL series. It pairs a vision encoder with a dense transformer decoder, using Interleaved-MRoPE positional embeddings and DeepStack multi-level feature fusion to handle images and videos alongside text.
